## Description

Rank securities by turnover or liquidity measures; some versions buy less-liquid stocks for a premium, others screen for tradability.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon risk-premium research where liquidity risk is compensated and capacity is sufficient.

## Vehicles

Equity factor funds, market-neutral portfolios, small-cap strategies.

## Required data

Daily dollar volume, bid-ask spreads, turnover, market cap, returns and borrow data.

## Caveats

Liquidity premiums are not free alpha; execution costs, price impact and capacity can overwhelm them.
